text:
Maya Chen: FYI — AcmeCorp renewal: customer wants to add 12 seats mid-term and pay via PO instead of card. Billing entity on PO: 'Acme Corp International' but contract signed by 'Acme Corp US'. Procurement says they need vendor code + W-9 + invoice line items.

Liam Patel: Got it. Pricing for 12 seats (pro-rated) = $9,600 one-time + monthly delta $1,200. Will need an addendum. We can keep term same.

Jordan Rivera: Finance: we can process PO but need W9 + exact PO amount + remit-to vendor code. If vendor code not in our system, we'll queue vendor onboarding (takes ~3 business days).

Priya Shah: Legal: billing entity change requires a signed addendum to the MSA (billing alias). I can draft a short amendment that also captures seat addendum. Docusign usually okay but note Claire's procurement sometimes blocks via SSO.

Claire Nguyen: procurement@acme: Procurement here — we can't issue PO to 'Acme Corp US' billing. The vendor in your system must match our legal billing entity. Also we can't use Docusign for this one. Need invoice/line items and PO number to proceed.

Docusign Bot: ERROR: signing_envelope_4512 - signer_not_in_org - envelope failed to deliver to recipient 'CFO Acme' (recipient email not verified)

Maya Chen: Ok. Workaround proposal:
1) Priya to draft a 1-page addendum (billing alias + seat prorate) for countersignature.
2) If Docusign fails, we accept PDF countersigned by CFO + attach PO. Finance to approve vendor onboarding upon W9 + matching PO.
3) Liam to send invoice line items in a form procurement likes (CSV or table).

Invoice snippet:
```
invoice_metadata:
  billing_alias: "Acme Corp International"
  line_items:
    - seats: 12
    - description: "Pro-rated add-on seats (Mar 1 — Feb 28)"
    - amount: "$9,600"
```

Jordan Rivera: Finance OK with that flow. One ask: send W9 to payments@redwood.com and copy me.

Priya Shah: I'll draft addendum now and post to this thread for quick review. If procurement insists on PO before signature, we can accept PO + signed PDF and then finalize.

Liam Patel: I'll ping procurement for PO template and include the invoice table. Maya, can you confirm target signers? (CFO + Procurement Manager)

Maya Chen: Yep — CFO Cheryl Park + Procurement Manager Sam Lee. Claire, can you confirm they'll sign PDF copy if Docusign blocked? 

Claire Nguyen: Yes, they can do a PDF countersign. I'll get PO + W9 by EOD Fri.

Maya Chen: Awesome. TL;DR: Need PO number + W9 + PO amount matching invoice by EOD Fri. Priya will drop addendum. I'll handle vendor code handoff to Jordan. :thumbsup:

Liam Patel: :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: on it.

Jordan Rivera: copied. will standby for W9.

Docusign Bot: Note: If envelope failure persists, escalate to platform@redwood for manual workaround.
